subject: Clarifying deployment preference and quickstart for hosted evaluation
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Chen <oliver@crestpay.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up + hosted evaluation options and next steps

Hi Oliver — thanks again for the demo time earlier. Quick recap and a few next-step questions so we can scope the right trial for CrestPay:

- Goal from call: validate hosted API for real-time fraud-assist and transaction enrichment in your checkout flow (low latency on chat/generation paths, embeddings for search).
- Expected steady-state: ~120 requests/s (chat-like calls) with short bursts up to 320 req/s for 10–20s.
- Residency/compliance notes you raised: PCI considerations and EU customer residency for a subset of traffic.

Options to consider (short):
1) Hosted API evaluation — fastest on-ramp, will provide sandbox endpoints matching expected ratebands, prefix/KV caching, and a plan for endpoint slices to mirror production traffic.
2) Dedicated capacity — if you need reserved GPU pools for sustained high throughput and stronger performance isolation.
3) Private (VPC/on-prem) — for customers requiring strict data residency and self-hosting; longer lead time.

Two quick asks so we can recommend a crisp trial: 1) confirm which subset of traffic needs EU residency (none / payment tokens only / full payload), 2) confirm whether 320 req/s bursts are per-region or aggregate.

Attached: Crestpay_MA_plan_v1.pdf (mutual action plan stub) and a short snapshot of the hosted quickstart we propose.

Proposed pilot path if you want to try Hosted first: 30–90 day sandbox with two endpoints (chat/generation + embeddings), an initial rate cap of 150 req/s per endpoint with an option to open to 320 req/s for a 48h stress window after validation, and a small SLA for uptime & latency SLOs during the trial. If you prefer, we can outline Dedicated pricing and timeline in parallel.

If this looks sensible, can you confirm by EOD Tue: which deployment you'd prefer to prioritize (hosted/dedicated/private) and who from your infra/security team should be in the loop?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 20m call to walk the plan.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Crestpay_MA_plan_v1.pdf (PDF, 82KB); redwood-quickstart-snapshot.md (text, 6KB)
From: Oliver Chen <oliver@crestpay.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@crestpay.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + hosted evaluation options and next steps

Priya — thanks for the clear recap. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Residency: we have EU residency requirements for cardholder data and some PII. For the pilot, we can limit EU traffic to a small subset (payment page only) to validate latency/residency behavior. That would be <10% of total traffic initially.
2) Throughput: the 320 req/s burst is aggregate across regions — not per-region. Steady state closer to 100–140 req/s.
3) Security checklist: do you have a standard SOC2 + PCI approach page or an evidence bundle we can send to procurement? We will need key management notes (KMS/HSM) and whether you can support Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) for the pilot.

Also looping Sarah — she’s leading infra and will help with network/egress questions.

Short answer: we’re inclined to prioritize Hosted for the quick validation, but we need the above residency and KMS answers to be comfortable. If Hosted can’t cover BYOK or EU residency for the payment subset, we’ll look at Dedicated.

Oliver
Oliver Chen
Head of Product, CrestPay
oliver@crestpay.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 12:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quick follow-up + hosted evaluation options and next steps

Priya — quick internal note on recommended approach for CrestPay.

- Given: aggregate bursts up to 320 req/s, EU residency for a payment subset (<10%), and BYOK requirement potential.
- Recommended pilot: Hosted evaluation first (fastest), with these guardrails:
  * Two sandbox endpoints: /v1/chat (generation) and /v1/embeddings. Map traffic slices to simulate EU-only payment traffic on an EU proxied endpoint.
  * Ratebands: start 150 req/s per endpoint, with on-demand burst window to 320 req/s for a 48h validation.
  * KMS/BYOK: confirm whether the Hosted control plane can integrate via customer-managed keys in the region (we can support AWS KMS BYOK for Hosted private tenant on our EU region; needs procurement sign-off).
  * Evidence bundle: supply SOC2 Type II summary + PCI controls matrix and a short technical note about network egress and VPC peering options for Dedicated/Private. Monica — can you attach the latest evidence bundle (prod SOC2 summary + KMS note)?

If CrestPay is comfortable with Hosted's BYOK options and the EU endpoint mapping, we’ll proceed with a 60-day hosted pilot. If not, queue Dedicated discovery (longer procurement).

— Jordan

Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted evaluation proposal + immediate action items (pilot set-up)

Oliver / Sarah — Thanks for the quick replies and for clarifying burst behavior and residency scope. Per Jordan’s note, here’s a short hosted evaluation proposal and the immediate asks so we can spin up a sandbox in the next 5 business days:

What we propose (Hosted evaluation — 60-day pilot):
- Endpoints: /v1/chat (generation) and /v1/embeddings. We will provision sandbox endpoints in both US and EU regions; EU region configured to only receive the payment-page traffic slice for residency testing.
- Rate plan: initial cap at 150 req/s per endpoint. We’ll enable a 48h burst window to 320 req/s (aggregate) after we validate integration and KV/prefix caching behavior.
- Security/compliance: we can provide our SOC2 Type II summary and a PCI controls mapping; we support AWS KMS BYOK for Hosted private tenants in our EU region (requires onboarding ticket to Infra for key provisioning). Monica attached the evidence bundle for procurement.
- Deliverables & timeline: sandbox endpoints + API keys (Day 1), traffic-mirroring plan + sample load script (Day 2–3), EU residency verification test (Day 7), 48h burst validation window (as agreed).

Immediate asks from CrestPay to start:
1) Confirm you want to prioritize Hosted for the pilot (yes/no) — please reply by EOD Wed.
2) Confirm the infra/security contact to receive the evidence bundle and coordinate KMS onboarding (we’ve cc’d Sarah; feel free to add a service account).
3) Approve a brief DocuSign mutual action plan if you’re ready to proceed: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-preview

If you prefer we can run a parallel Dedicated discovery (I’ll pull the DD checklist) but that will add ~3–4 weeks to procurement.

Thanks — happy to schedule a 20m call to run alignment in the next 48h.

Best,
Priya
